Dear {vendor} team,

Thank you for your notice that the {plan} plan under {agreement} will change from {old_price} to {new_price}, with the change taking effect on {effective_date}. The increase of {increase_pct}, or {monthly_increase} per month, would add {annual_impact} over a year for our business.

We would like to keep our current price of {old_price} on {agreement}. Before the new price takes effect, we ask that you confirm whether that rate can be maintained, or let us know which options are available to us, such as a different plan or a longer term at a fixed rate.

Please reply by {deadline} so we can decide how to proceed before the change takes effect.

Best regards,

{sender}
